title: cardamomum grana-paradisi
intro: Cardamomum grana-paradisi, commonly known as Green Cardamom or Elaichi, is a herbaceous perennial plant in the ginger family (Zingiberaceae) that is native to India and Southeast Asia. The health benefits of Cardamomum grana-paradisi include its ability to aid digestion, reduce nausea and vomiting, and exhibit antimicrobial and anti-inflammatory properties. The therapeutic actions of Cardamomum grana-paradisi include its use as a carminative, expectorant, and antiemetic, making it a popular ingredient in traditional medicine for treating digestive issues and other ailments. The bioactive constituents of Cardamomum grana-paradisi include volatile oils, such as limonene, alpha-pinene, and beta-pinene, as well as flavonoids, terpenoids, and other compounds that contribute to its medicinal properties.
